questions.title: Which brand will be Kylian Mbappe’s principal personal sportswear sponsor on September 18, 2026?
questions.background: Kylian Mbappe is a Real Madrid forward with a longstanding individual sponsorship agreement with Nike.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official sponsorship announcements by Mbappe or the sponsoring brand, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the brand holding Mbappe’s principal individual sportswear sponsorship as of September 18, 2026. If no sponsorship change has been announced by that date, resolve to his incumbent sponsor. Club kit suppliers and endorsements outside sportswear do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sportswear brand.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-09-11 time-decay update: Exa search across Aug 30-Sept 11 returned zero announcements, leaks, or rival-deal reports for Kylian Mbappe's personal sportswear sponsorship, and extensive local coverage through Sept 11 (Real Madrid hat-trick vs Sociedad, UCL goal vs Inter, France Football Ballon d'Or interview) shows zero boot-switch buzz. Twelve additional silent days have elapsed since Aug 30 (42 days since Nike expiry), leaving only 7 days until the Sept 18 resolution cutoff under which any unannounced/status-quo outcome resolves to incumbent Nike (which also holds a 6-month matching right). Constant-hazard decay pushes Nike toward ~0.90, but respecting anti-overconfidence discipline on unfinalized corporate announcements we raise Nike 0.77 -> 0.85 and compress rivals proportionally (On 0.04, Adidas 0.02, Under Armour 0.015, Puma 0.01; sum 0.935, leaving 0.065 for unexpected equity entrants).
